how: Pick examples that cover the variation you expect, keep the label balance roughly even, order them randomly, and make the final unlabeled item exactly match the example format.
name: Few-Shot Prompting
what: Showing the model two to five worked examples of the task inside the prompt so it infers the pattern before doing yours.
paper: Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (2020)
when_fails: Multi-step reasoning (examples of answers do not teach the steps), and it can backfire through example bias: models overweight the majority label, the most recent example, and surface formatting quirks.
when_works: Format transfer, labeling and classification, style imitation, and any task where the shape of a good answer is easier to show than to describe.
